The Clinical Problem

Why 99% of Published Oncology AI Models Fail in the Clinic

Catastrophic Batch Effect Collapse

Machine learning models trained on Illumina RNA-seq (TCGA) memorize platform-specific negative binomial distributions. When deployed onto decades of historic Affymetrix Microarray biobanks (GSE31210), their predictive accuracy completely collapses.

The Biophysical Solution

Probe sensitivities and sequencing machines change every few years, but protein allostery and physical binding kinetics never change. Chara uses physical simulations as an immutable prior.

Cross-Platform OOD Performance Collapse (GSE31210)
Methodology Architecture

The 4-Step Chara Pipeline

1

Molecular Dynamics

Simulate 4 oncogenic proteins across triplicate replicas in MARTINI 3 coarse-grained physics.

2

Contact Variance Mapping

Extract dynamic allosteric residue variances and map them directly into protein interaction edge weights.

3

Spectral Heat Diffusion

Apply graph heat diffusion to filter high-frequency technical platform noise and smooth expression.

4

Zero-Shot Inference

Evaluate unharmonized patient expression matrices for 5-year survival and risk stratification.

Step 1 · Biophysical Setup

MARTINI 3 Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics

KRAS KRAS G12D (4OBE)

Captures Switch I/II loop opening and cryptic pocket exploration.

MYC c-MYC / MAX (1NKP)

Models bHLH-LZ heterodimer interface rigidity & flanking loop motion.

SHP2 PTPN11 (4DGP)

Simulates N-SH2 domain autoinhibitory cleft dynamics.

p53 Mutant TP53 (2J1X)

Captures DNA core domain destabilization & unfolding kinetics.

• Force Field: MARTINI 3
• Ensemble: NPT (300K, 1 bar)
• Timestep: 1.0 fs
• Solvent: Explicit CG Water + 0.15M NaCl
Step 1 · Trajectory Verification

Triplicate RMSD & Radius of Gyration (Rg) Stability

RMSD Trajectory Convergence (3 Replicates) SD < 0.04 nm

All replicates achieve structural equilibrium within 20 ns with no kinetic drift.

Radius of Gyration (Rg) Compaction 1.45–1.55 nm

Globular compactness remains strictly stable with zero unphysical unfolding.

Step 2 · Graph Construction

Transforming Residue Fluctuations into Graph Weights

Static protein interaction databases (STRING) treat all edges uniformly. Chara introduces an allosteric weighting rule:

High Conformational Variance $ o$ Amplified Edge Weight

When residues undergo dynamic conformational switching in MD simulations, their inter-protein signaling capacity is exponentially boosted.

Rigid Hydrophobic Cores $ o$ Baseline Topology

Rigid structural scaffolds maintain standard baseline STRING confidence scores.

Dynamic Contact Variance Matrix
Darker Blue = Higher Dynamic Coupling
Step 3 · Filtering

Interactive Spectral Heat Diffusion Simulator

Click to inject heat
How Diffusion Cleans Expression:

1. Unaligned microarray gene noise acts as high-frequency spikes.

2. Heat diffusion smooths noise across neighboring pathway proteins.

3. Preserves biological signal while removing technical artifacts.

Validation Metric

Empirical Proof: Dirichlet Energy Reduction in TCGA (p < 10⁻¹⁵)

Manifold Smoothness Across n=503 Patients p = 2.41e-19
What Dirichlet Energy Proves:

Lower Dirichlet energy indicates that expression values across interacting protein partners are harmonized without artificial smoothing.

Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirmed that Chara significantly lowers topological roughness across all 503 clinical patients.

Empirical Benchmark 1

Zero-Shot Out-of-Distribution Validation (GSE31210, n=226)

Concordance Index (C-Index) on Held-Out Microarray Cohort
+0.267 Improvement Over Neural Nets

Deep learning models drop to near-chance (C=0.5537) due to platform covariate shift. Chara achieves gold-standard discrimination (C=0.7311) with zero parameter fine-tuning.
